up: List all approved drugs indicated for breast cancer, including their ChEMBL ID, preferred name, canonical SMILES structure, and indication details (MeSH heading and EFO term). Include only drugs with max_phase = 4.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, di.mesh_heading, di.efo_term FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN compound_records cr ON md.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN drug_indication di ON cr.record_id = di.record_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE md.max_phase = 4 AND di.mesh_heading LIKE '%BREAST%';
